Initial release of smyx-child-happy-moment-capture-analysis:

- Real-time analysis of children's behavior and expressions via fixed cameras to identify happy moments (big laughter, jumping, clapping, joyful reactions).
- Automatically captures high-definition photos or short video clips upon detecting a happy event.
- Generates and pushes a "Happy Diary" to the parent’s mobile app, with instant encouragement sound or music.
- Daily and weekly happiness collections are automatically compiled.
- Strict open-id acquisition and privacy controls, ensuring reports are only accessed via authorized cloud queries.
- Designed for use in homes, kindergartens, playgrounds, and parent-child activity centers.
